Agent Name: NumericalAlgorithms_Expert
 Step Number: 1
 Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the required convergence criterion. They used a tolerance check |x_{n+1} − x_n| < 1e-4 to declare convergence instead of the specified condition that x_n and x_{n+1} be equal after rounding to four decimal places. This led to reporting n = 3, whereas the first n where rounding stabilizes is n = 2 (since x2 and x3 both round to -4.9361).
